rules.source_scope: Plugin-Owned Hard Constraints: Docker-only PoC and no host fallback

carriers.symbol: PoCs, exploit payloads, and verification traffic run only inside Docker

rules.rationale: Host fallback is a top-level safety boundary and remains visible before phase references load.
rules.residual_boundary: Docker availability alone is not confirmation; the verification and bundle gates still apply.

rules.source_scope: Static scanning, dependency, checklist, playbook, and LLM output routing

carriers.symbol: Scanner, static, dependency, checklist, playbook, and LLM results are

rules.rationale: Candidate-only routing prevents evidence-free promotion and must remain in the kernel.
rules.residual_boundary: A candidate may advance only through independent Docker verification and downstream gates.

rules.source_scope: Confirmed requires attacker entrypoint, Docker oracle, verdict, disposition, and bundle

carriers.symbol: Confirmed requires a real attacker-controlled entrypoint
Only this contract may recommend confirmed_in_docker

rules.rationale: This is the central confirmation invariant and cannot depend on optional reading.
rules.residual_boundary: No single carrier alone grants final confirmed deliverable status.

rules.source_scope: Blocked Docker/runtime verification versus no-confirmed completion
rules.rationale: A runtime failure cannot be misreported as a clean security result.
rules.residual_boundary: Material unverified leads remain blocked until their explicit safety rationale or verification is complete.

rules.source_scope: Tested ref, source-bound validity, and fixture provenance limits

carriers.symbol: Bind every claim to the exact tested source ref

rules.rationale: Source and fixture boundaries prevent stronger real-world claims than evidence supports.
rules.residual_boundary: Synthetic identity, privilege, secrets, or deployment properties never support upstream impact.

rules.source_scope: Unsafe sandbox rejection cannot enter confirmed output
rules.rationale: Unsafe execution must fail closed before any confirmation path.
rules.residual_boundary: Rewrite the verification case and rerun; never reinterpret rejection as evidence.

rules.source_scope: Docker cleanup and OMC teammate PID hygiene
rules.rationale: Cleanup must not destroy unrelated Docker resources or teammate processes.
rules.residual_boundary: Only exact audit-owned labeled resources may be applied after review; PID termination stays outside Zhulong.

rules.source_scope: Severity escalation and seeded variant discovery are distinct closure passes

carriers.symbol: Severity escalation and seeded variant discovery are separate required

rules.rationale: Similarity search does not prove stronger impact, and impact testing does not cover variants.
rules.residual_boundary: Both passes remain independently evidence-bound.

rules.source_scope: Variant candidates require independent Docker reproduction and bundle

carriers.symbol: Each variant remains a candidate until its own Docker reproduction

rules.rationale: Seed resemblance cannot substitute for independent confirmation.
rules.residual_boundary: Candidate ranking and seed similarity remain auxiliary evidence only.

rules.source_scope: Contract-first staging, final validation, batch validation, and promotion
rules.rationale: Direct writes to final confirmed output bypass atomic validation and promotion.
rules.residual_boundary: Preflight and all-errors diagnostics never replace final and batch validation.

rules.source_scope: Canonical finalization event and gate authority

carriers.symbol: Only the canonical finalization gate and event establish completion

rules.rationale: Derived summaries and state views must not manufacture completion.
rules.residual_boundary: Finalization remains contingent on the selected result and every upstream gate.

rules.source_scope: Recording occurs after bundle confirmation and is rollback-safe

carriers.symbol: Recording is an opt-in post-bundle gate

rules.rationale: Recording failure must never damage or de-confirm the original bundle.
rules.residual_boundary: Recording evidence has no vulnerability confirmation authority.

rules.source_scope: Context plan, handoff, checkpoint, and next-actions authority boundary

carriers.symbol: Context plans, handoffs, checkpoints, and next-actions are advisory
It is not authority for candidates

rules.rationale: Derived context and state indexes cannot become implicit execution or confirmation gates.
rules.residual_boundary: Mandatory context means reading priority only and never proves actual reading or compliance.

rules.source_scope: Confirmed bundle path and private-material portability boundary

carriers.symbol: Confirmed bundles must not leak local absolute paths

rules.rationale: Reviewer-facing bundles must be portable and must not disclose local or private context.
rules.residual_boundary: Bundle-relative paths and sanitized public issue text remain mandatory.

rules.source_scope: Repository preparation, target identity, attack surface, and Recon result details
rules.rationale: Detailed Recon operations are phase-scoped and backed by the Recon validator.
rules.residual_boundary: The kernel retains source identity and non-authority invariants.

rules.source_scope: Candidate identity, deduplication, triage batch, and narrow stage finalization
rules.rationale: Field and command detail belongs at candidate and triage time.
rules.residual_boundary: The kernel preserves candidate-only and blocked-not-complete boundaries.

rules.source_scope: Sandbox, Docker wrapper, entrypoint, oracle, and severity operation details
rules.rationale: Verification commands and exit routing are backed by the fixed Docker wrapper.
rules.residual_boundary: The kernel keeps Docker-only, attacker-entrypoint, and unsafe-sandbox invariants.

rules.source_scope: Seed extraction, candidate search, file layout, and validation commands
rules.rationale: Variant mechanics are relevant only after a valid seed exists.
rules.residual_boundary: The kernel retains independent reproduction and separate severity-pass requirements.

rules.source_scope: Bundle fields, staging commands, cleanup procedure, disposition, and finalization details
rules.rationale: Long packaging and cleanup instructions are backed by production gates and phase references.
rules.residual_boundary: The kernel retains atomic promotion, portability, cleanup, and canonical finalization invariants.

rules.source_scope: Recording identity, checkpoint, screenshots, archive, and rollback operations
rules.rationale: Recording operations apply only after bundle confirmation and have their own validator.
rules.residual_boundary: The kernel retains opt-in, post-bundle, and rollback-safe boundaries.

rules.source_scope: R2 journal/state, handoff, checkpoint, next-actions, resume, and rebuild details
rules.rationale: Continuation mechanics are cross-phase details backed by R2 validators and CAS.
rules.residual_boundary: The kernel retains derived-state non-authority and canonical finalization.

rules.source_scope: Language playbook list and source-to-sink exploration detail
rules.rationale: The context catalog selects relevant playbooks without listing every file in the root Skill.
rules.residual_boundary: Playbooks remain starting maps, never exhaustive fences or confirmation evidence.

rules.source_scope: DOCX, attachment, replay helper, pause, transcript, and diagnostic field details
rules.rationale: Reviewer artifact field detail already has dedicated references and validators.
rules.residual_boundary: The kernel retains contract-first staging, validation, portability, and one-vulnerability boundaries.

rules.source_scope: Docker baseline, adoption flags, exact resource cleanup, and strict-clean commands
rules.rationale: Cleanup procedure is lengthy and already isolated in the Docker hygiene reference.
rules.residual_boundary: The root kernel still forbids broad prune, baseline forgery, and teammate PID signaling.
